data.long_meaning: Beautiful, Delicate, and Graceful. Derived from the Arabic word 'lami' which means 'flowing' or 'graceful'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lamiyaat usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
